name: Alchemist
source: Pathfinder GM Core, "Building Creatures", Class Road Maps, via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/Rules.aspx?ID=2874
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder GM Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: Low Perception; high Crafting; high Int, moderate or better Dex or Str; low to moderate HP; moderate attack with bombs. Abilities: Infused alchemical items, Quick Bomber if a bomber alchemist, a few other alchemist abilities; it's usually easier to give the alchemist their bomb items rather than use Quick Alchemy on the spot

notes.attributes: High Intelligence; moderate or better Dexterity or Strength (set: moderate Dexterity).
notes.specials: Infused alchemical items, Quick Bomber if a bomber alchemist, a few other alchemist abilities; it's usually easier to give the alchemist their bomb items rather than use Quick Alchemy on the spot.
